---
title: "Network Explorer"
page-layout: article        # removes the content column margins
margin-left: "0px"
margin-right: "0px"
---

```{=html}
<div id="network-root">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="network-scoped.css">

<style>
  #network-root {
    height: calc(100vh - 80px); /* 60px = Quarto navbar, adjust if needed */
  }
</style>

<header class="header">

  <div class="controls">
    <!-- Simulated Data (lines 1-2) -->
    <span class="control-section-title">Simulated Data</span>
    <div class="filter-group">
      <label for="filter-N" class="filter-label">N:</label>
      <select id="filter-N" class="filter-select"></select>
    </div>

    <div class="filter-group">
      <label for="filter-M" class="filter-label">M:</label>
      <select id="filter-M" class="filter-select"></select>
    </div>

    <div class="filter-group">
      <label for="filter-openmindedness" class="filter-label">Open:</label>
      <select id="filter-openmindedness" class="filter-select"></select>
    </div>

    <div class="filter-group">
      <label for="filter-social_posting" class="filter-label">Post:</label>
      <select id="filter-social_posting" class="filter-select">
        <option value="">any</option>
        <option value="true">ON</option>
        <option value="false">OFF</option>
      </select>
    </div>

    <div class="filter-group">
      <label for="filter-seed" class="filter-label">Seed:</label>
      <select id="filter-seed" class="filter-select"></select>
    </div>

    <div class="filter-group">
      <label for="filter-t" class="filter-label">t:</label>
      <select id="filter-t" class="filter-select"></select>
    </div>

    <div class="filter-status" id="filter-status">No files</div>   

    <div class="filter-group">
      <label for="filter-run" class="filter-label">Run:</label>
      <select id="filter-run" class="filter-select" style="min-width:110px;"></select>
    </div>

    <div class="loaded-filename">
      File:
       <span class="loaded-filename" id="loaded-name"></span>
    </div>

    <div class="legend">
      <div class="legend__item" id="legend-agents">
        <div class="legend__dot" style="background:var(--color-agent)"></div>
        <span>Agents (<span id="count-agents">0</span>)</span>
      </div>
      <div class="legend__item" id="legend-stmts">
        <div class="legend__dot" style="background:var(--color-stmt)"></div>
        <span>Statements (<span id="count-stmts">0</span>)</span>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="controls__linebreak"></div>
  
    <span class="control-section-title">Network Type</span>
    <div class="filter-group" style="display:inline-flex;align-items:center;">
      <select id="filter-nettype" class="filter-select" style="min-width:175px;">
        <option value="AS">Agent–Statement</option>
        <option value="AA">Projection: Agents</option>
        <option value="SS">Projection: Statements</option>
      </select>
    </div>

    <button class="btn" id="btn-weight-forces" disabled title="Use edge weight to scale attraction force (projection networks only)">Weight forces: off</button>

    <div class="control-group">
      <label class="control-group__label" title="Hide links with weight below this threshold (projection networks only).">MIN WEIGHT</label>
      <input type="range" class="slider" id="sl-minweight" min="1" max="10" step="1" value="1" disabled>
      <span class="control-group__value" id="vl-minweight">1</span>
    </div>

    <div class="controls__linebreak"></div>

    <span class="control-section-title">Dynamic Layout</span>
    <div class="control-group">
      <label class="control-group__label" title="Repulsion between all nodes: Higher values push nodes further apart (Fruchterman-Reingold repulsive force).">SPREAD</label>
      <input type="range" class="slider" id="sl-spread" min="10" max="400" step="5" value="100">
      <span class="control-group__value" id="vl-spread">100</span>
    </div>

    <div class="control-group">
      <label class="control-group__label" title="Preferred distance between connected nodes: The rest length of the spring pulling them together.">EDGE LENGTH</label>
      <input type="range" class="slider" id="sl-edgelen" min="10" max="100" step="2" value="10">
      <span class="control-group__value" id="vl-edgelen">10</span>
    </div>

    <div class="control-group">
      <label class="control-group__label" title="How strongly edges pull connected nodes toward each other: Higher values create tighter clusters.">ATTRACTION</label>
      <input type="range" class="slider" id="sl-attract" min="0" max="1" step="0.02" value="0.75">
      <span class="control-group__value" id="vl-attract">0.75</span>
    </div>

    <button class="btn" id="btn-reset">&#x21BA; Reset</button>
    <button class="btn" id="btn-defaults">Default Controls</button>

    <div class="divider"></div>

    <button class="btn" id="btn-freeze">&#x23F8; Freeze</button>
    <button class="btn" id="btn-labels">Labels off</button>
    <button class="btn" id="btn-size">Statement size: uniform</button>

  </div>

</header>

<div class="canvas-wrapper" id="canvas-wrapper">
  <svg class="graph-svg" id="graph"></svg>

  <!-- Zoom controls: positioned top-left below main controls -->
  <div class="zoom-controls" id="zoom-controls">
    <button class="btn btn--zoom" id="btn-zoom-in" title="Zoom in">+</button>
    <button class="btn btn--zoom" id="btn-zoom-out" title="Zoom out">−</button>
  </div>

  <!-- Small cursor tooltip: shows on hover for statements and brief agent info -->
  <div class="cursor-tooltip" id="cursor-tooltip"></div>

  <!-- Worldview pane: opens on agent click, lists connected statements -->
  <div class="worldview-pane" id="worldview-pane">
    <div class="worldview-pane__header">
      <div class="worldview-pane__title" id="worldview-title"></div>
      <button class="worldview-pane__close" id="worldview-close">&#x2715;</button>
    </div>
    <div class="worldview-pane__list" id="worldview-list"></div>
  </div>

  <!-- Statement pane: opens on statement click, lists connected agents -->
  <div class="worldview-pane" id="statement-pane">
    <div class="worldview-pane__header">
      <div class="worldview-pane__title" id="statement-title"></div>
      <button class="worldview-pane__close" id="statement-close">&#x2715;</button>
    </div>
    <div class="worldview-pane__list" id="statement-list"></div>
  </div>

  <div class="status-bar" id="status-bar">Initialising&hellip;</div>
</div>

<style>
  /* Let Quarto's body/main have no extra padding */
  main.content { padding: 0 !important; }

  /* Make canvas-wrapper fill whatever remains below the header */
  #canvas-wrapper {
    height: calc(100vh - var(--quarto-navbar-height, 60px) - var(--header-height, 0px));
  }
</style>

<script>
  // Measure the actual .header height and set it as a CSS variable
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
    const h = document.querySelector('.header');
    if (h) {
      document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--header-height', h.offsetHeight + 'px');
    }
  });
</script>

<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/d3/7.8.5/d3.min.js"></script>
<script>
const DATA = { nodes: [], links: [] };

// ── Empty state ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
if (!DATA.nodes || DATA.nodes.length === 0) {
  document.getElementById("status-bar").textContent =
    "No network loaded \u2014 select one from the dropdown or use \u201C\u23CF Local JSON\u201D.";
}

// ── Helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Safely extract string id from a D3 link endpoint (may be mutated to object)
function eid(x) { return (x !== null && typeof x === "object") ? x.id : x; }

// ── Build neighbour index from current DATA ───────────────────────
const degree     = {};
const neighbours = {};
let   nodeById   = {};

function buildIndex() {
  Object.keys(degree).forEach(k => delete degree[k]);
  Object.keys(neighbours).forEach(k => delete neighbours[k]);
  nodeById = {};
  DATA.nodes.forEach(n => {
    degree[n.id]     = 0;
    neighbours[n.id] = new Set();
    nodeById[n.id]   = n;
  });
  DATA.links.forEach(l => {
    // Use raw string ids from source/target — before D3 mutates them
    // We store original string ids in l._s / l._t at load time
    const s = l._s, t = l._t;
    if (s === undefined || t === undefined) return;
    degree[s] = (degree[s] || 0) + 1;
    degree[t] = (degree[t] || 0) + 1;
    neighbours[s].add(t);
    neighbours[t].add(s);
  });
}

// Tag each link with immutable string ids before D3 can mutate them
function tagLinks() {
  DATA.links.forEach(l => {
    l._s = eid(l.source);
    l._t = eid(l.target);
  });
}

if (DATA.nodes && DATA.nodes.length > 0) {
  tagLinks();
  buildIndex();
}

// ── Node radius ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
const AGENT_R      = 5;
const STMT_BASE_R  = 7;

function nodeR(d, byDeg) {
  if (d.type === "agent") return AGENT_R;   // agents always fixed size
  if (!byDeg) return STMT_BASE_R;
  // Area proportional to degree → radius proportional to sqrt(degree)
  const deg = degree[d.id] || 0;
  return deg === 0 ? STMT_BASE_R : Math.max(4, Math.min(Math.sqrt(deg) * 5, 30));
}

// ── DOM refs ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const wrap          = document.getElementById("canvas-wrapper");
const cursorTip     = document.getElementById("cursor-tooltip");
const worldviewPane = document.getElementById("worldview-pane");
const worldviewTitle= document.getElementById("worldview-title");
const worldviewList = document.getElementById("worldview-list");
const statusBar     = document.getElementById("status-bar");

// ── SVG setup ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const svg  = d3.select("#graph");
const root = svg.append("g");

const zoomBehavior = d3.zoom().scaleExtent([0.04, 10]).on("zoom", e => root.attr("transform", e.transform));
svg.call(zoomBehavior)
   .on("dblclick.zoom", null);

const linkGroup = root.append("g");
const nodeGroup = root.append("g");

let linkSel, nodeSel, circles;

// ── Simulation ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
let sim;
let frozen    = false;
let labelsOn  = false;
let sizeByDeg = false;
let netType               = "AS";
let rawData               = { nodes: [], links: [] };
let weightedForces        = false;
let attractBeforeWeightOn = null;
let minWeight             = 1;

const NET_DEFAULTS = {
  AS: { spread: 100,  edgelen: 10,  attract: 0.75  },
  AA: { spread: 200,  edgelen: 30,  attract: 0.075 },
  SS: { spread: 200,  edgelen: 30,  attract: 0.075 },
};

function sv(id) { return +document.getElementById(id).value; }
function wh()   { return [wrap.clientWidth, wrap.clientHeight]; }

// Returns a scalar or per-link function for forceLink.strength()
function linkStrength() {
  const base = sv("sl-attract");
  if (!weightedForces || netType === "AS") return base;
  const maxW = d3.max(DATA.links, l => l.weight || 1) || 1;
  return d => Math.min((d.weight || 1) / maxW, 1) * base;
}

function buildSim() {
  const [W, H] = wh();
  if (sim) sim.stop();
  sim = d3.forceSimulation(DATA.nodes)
    .force("link",    d3.forceLink(DATA.links).id(d => d.id)
                        .distance(sv("sl-edgelen")).strength(linkStrength()))
    .force("charge",  d3.forceManyBody().strength(-sv("sl-spread")))
    .force("center",  d3.forceCenter(W / 2, H / 2))
    .force("collide", d3.forceCollide(d => nodeR(d, sizeByDeg) + 2))
    .on("tick", onTick)
    .on("end",  () => { statusBar.textContent = "Converged."; });
  statusBar.textContent = "Simulating\u2026";
}

function onTick() {
  linkSel.attr("x1", d => d.source.x).attr("y1", d => d.source.y)
         .attr("x2", d => d.target.x).attr("y2", d => d.target.y);
  nodeSel.attr("transform", d => "translate(" + d.x + "," + d.y + ")");
}

// ── Draw / redraw ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
function updateLegend() {
  const nAgents = DATA.nodes.filter(n => n.type === "agent").length;
  const nStmts  = DATA.nodes.filter(n => n.type === "statement").length;
  document.getElementById("count-agents").textContent = nAgents;
  document.getElementById("count-stmts").textContent  = nStmts;
  document.getElementById("legend-agents").style.display = netType === "SS" ? "none" : "";
  document.getElementById("legend-stmts").style.display  = netType === "AA" ? "none" : "";
}

function redrawLinks() {
  linkGroup.selectAll("line").remove();
  linkSel = linkGroup.selectAll("line")
    .data(DATA.links)
    .join("line")
    .attr("class", "edge")
    // .style() overrides the CSS rule; .attr() would be overridden by it
    .style("stroke-width", d =>
      netType !== "AS" && d.weight != null
        ? Math.max(0.5, Math.min(Math.sqrt(d.weight) * 1.5, 12)) + "px"
        : null   // null removes inline style → CSS .edge rule takes over
    );
}

function redraw() {
  redrawLinks();
  nodeGroup.selectAll("g").remove();

  // Key function uses the stable _s/_t tags, not the (possibly mutated) source/target
  nodeSel = nodeGroup.selectAll("g")
    .data(DATA.nodes, d => d.id)
    .join("g")
    .attr("class", "node")
    .call(d3.drag()
      .on("start", (e,d) => {
        if(!frozen) {
          d._didDrag = false;
          d.fx = d.x; d.fy = d.y;
        }
      })
      .on("drag",  (e,d) => {
        if(!frozen) {
          if (!d._didDrag) {
            sim.alphaTarget(0.3).restart();
            d._didDrag = true;
          }
          d.fx = e.x; d.fy = e.y;
        }
      })
      .on("end",   (e,d) => {
        if(!frozen) {
          if (!e.active) sim.alphaTarget(0);
          d.fx = null; d.fy = null;
          delete d._didDrag;
        }
      })
    )
    .on("mouseover", onHover)
    .on("mousemove", onMove)
    .on("mouseout",  onOut)
    .on("click",     onClick);

  circles = nodeSel.append("circle")
    .attr("class",  "node__circle")
    .attr("r",      d => nodeR(d, sizeByDeg))
    .attr("fill",   d => d.type === "agent" ? "var(--color-agent)" : "var(--color-stmt)")
    .attr("stroke", d => d.type === "agent" ? "var(--color-agent-stroke)" : "var(--color-stmt-stroke)");

  nodeSel.append("text")
    .attr("class", "node__label")
    .attr("dy", d => d.type === "agent" ? -8 : -10)
    .attr("text-anchor", "middle")
    .html(d => {
      if (d.type === "statement") {
        return '<tspan class="node__label-id">' + d.id + '</tspan> ' + d.label;
      }
      return d.label;
    });

  // Apply current label visibility state to freshly created nodes
  nodeSel.classed("node--labels-hidden", !labelsOn);
  updateLegend();
}

// ── Initial draw ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
if (DATA.nodes && DATA.nodes.length > 0) {
  redraw();
  buildSim();
}

// ── Sliders ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function bindSlider(slId, vlId, dec, fn) {
  const sl = document.getElementById(slId);
  const vl = document.getElementById(vlId);
  sl.addEventListener("input", () => { vl.textContent = (+sl.value).toFixed(dec); fn(+sl.value); });
}
bindSlider("sl-spread",  "vl-spread",  0, v => {
  sim.force("charge", d3.forceManyBody().strength(-v)); sim.alpha(0.4).restart(); });
bindSlider("sl-edgelen", "vl-edgelen", 0, v => {
  sim.force("link").distance(v); sim.alpha(0.4).restart(); });
bindSlider("sl-attract", "vl-attract", 2, () => {
  sim.force("link").strength(linkStrength()); sim.alpha(0.4).restart(); });
bindSlider("sl-minweight", "vl-minweight", 0, () => {
  if (netType !== "AS") applyWeightFilter(); });

// ── Buttons ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
document.getElementById("btn-reset").addEventListener("click", () => {
  frozen = false;
  document.getElementById("btn-freeze").textContent = "\u23F8 Freeze";
  DATA.nodes.forEach(d => { d.x=undefined; d.y=undefined; d.vx=0; d.vy=0; d.fx=null; d.fy=null; });
  buildSim();
  sim.alpha(1).restart();
});

document.getElementById("btn-freeze").addEventListener("click", function() {
  frozen = !frozen;
  if (frozen) { sim.stop(); this.textContent = "\u25B6 Unfreeze"; }
  else        { sim.alpha(0.3).restart(); this.textContent = "\u23F8 Freeze"; }
});

document.getElementById("btn-labels").addEventListener("click", function() {
  labelsOn = !labelsOn;
  nodeSel.classed("node--labels-hidden", !labelsOn);
  this.textContent = labelsOn ? "Labels on" : "Labels off";
  this.classList.toggle("btn--active", labelsOn);
});

document.getElementById("btn-size").addEventListener("click", function() {
  sizeByDeg = !sizeByDeg;
  this.classList.toggle("btn--active", sizeByDeg);
  this.textContent = sizeByDeg ? "Statement size: degree" : "Statement size: uniform";
  // Only statement circles change; agents stay fixed
  circles.filter(d => d.type === "statement")
    .transition().duration(400)
    .attr("r", d => nodeR(d, sizeByDeg));
  sim.force("collide", d3.forceCollide(d => nodeR(d, sizeByDeg) + 2));
  sim.alpha(0.15).restart();
});

document.getElementById("filter-nettype").addEventListener("change", applyNetType);

document.getElementById("btn-weight-forces").addEventListener("click", function() {
  weightedForces = !weightedForces;
  this.textContent = weightedForces ? "Weight forces: on" : "Weight forces: off";
  this.classList.toggle("btn--active", weightedForces);
  // Scale attraction by ×4 when enabling; restore previous value when disabling
  if (weightedForces) {
    attractBeforeWeightOn = sv("sl-attract");
    const newA = Math.min(sv("sl-attract") * 4, 1);
    document.getElementById("sl-attract").value = newA;
    document.getElementById("vl-attract").textContent = newA.toFixed(3).replace(/\.?0+$/, "");
  } else {
    const restoreA = attractBeforeWeightOn !== null ? attractBeforeWeightOn : sv("sl-attract") / 4;
    attractBeforeWeightOn = null;
    document.getElementById("sl-attract").value = restoreA;
    document.getElementById("vl-attract").textContent = restoreA.toFixed(3).replace(/\.?0+$/, "");
  }
  sim.force("link").strength(linkStrength());
  sim.alpha(0.4).restart();
});

document.getElementById("btn-defaults").addEventListener("click", () => {
  const d = NET_DEFAULTS[netType] || NET_DEFAULTS.AS;
  const attract = weightedForces ? Math.min(d.attract * 4, 1) : d.attract;
  setSliders({ ...d, attract });
  attractBeforeWeightOn = weightedForces ? d.attract : null;
  sim.force("charge", d3.forceManyBody().strength(-d.spread));
  sim.force("link").distance(d.edgelen).strength(linkStrength());
  sim.alpha(0.4).restart();
});

// ── Zoom controls ────────────────────────────────────────────
document.getElementById("btn-zoom-in").addEventListener("click", () => {
  svg.transition().duration(300).call(zoomBehavior.scaleBy, 1.3);
});

document.getElementById("btn-zoom-out").addEventListener("click", () => {
  svg.transition().duration(300).call(zoomBehavior.scaleBy, 1 / 1.3);
});

// ── Hover ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function onHover(event, d) {
  const nb = new Set([d.id, ...(neighbours[d.id] || [])]);
  linkSel.classed("edge--highlighted", l => l._s === d.id || l._t === d.id);
  linkSel.filter(function() { return d3.select(this).classed("edge--highlighted"); }).raise();
  nodeSel.classed("node--highlighted", n =>  nb.has(n.id))
         .classed("node--dimmed",      n => !nb.has(n.id));

  if (d.type === "agent") {
    const count = (neighbours[d.id] || new Set()).size;
    cursorTip.textContent = d.label + " \u00B7 " + count + " link" + (count !== 1 ? "s" : "");
  } else {
    const deg = (neighbours[d.id] || new Set()).size;
    cursorTip.innerHTML = '<span class="cursor-tip-id">' + d.id + '</span> ' + d.label
      + (d.topic ? " \u00B7 " + d.topic : "")
      + " \u00B7 " + deg + " link" + (deg !== 1 ? "s" : "");
    // Highlight matching row in open worldview pane
    worldviewList.querySelectorAll(".worldview-pane__item").forEach(el =>
      el.classList.toggle("worldview-pane__item--highlighted", el.dataset.id === d.id)
    );
  }
  cursorTip.style.display = "block";
}

function onMove(event) {
  const r  = wrap.getBoundingClientRect();
  const tw = cursorTip.offsetWidth;
  const th = cursorTip.offsetHeight;
  let x = event.clientX - r.left + 16;
  let y = event.clientY - r.top  - 10;
  if (x + tw > wrap.clientWidth  - 10) x -= tw + 32;
  if (y + th > wrap.clientHeight - 10) y  = wrap.clientHeight - th - 10;
  cursorTip.style.left = x + "px";
  cursorTip.style.top  = y + "px";
}

function onOut() {
  cursorTip.style.display = "none";
  linkSel.classed("edge--highlighted", false);
  nodeSel.classed("node--highlighted", false).classed("node--dimmed", false);
  worldviewList.querySelectorAll(".worldview-pane__item").forEach(el =>
    el.classList.remove("worldview-pane__item--highlighted")
  );
}

// ── Click: worldview for agents, info panel for statements ────────
function openWorldview(d) {
  const stmts = Array.from(neighbours[d.id] || [])
    .map(id => nodeById[id])
    .filter(n => n && n.type === "statement")
    .sort((a, b) => a.id.localeCompare(b.id, undefined, {numeric: true}));

  worldviewTitle.textContent = d.label + "\u2019s Worldview";
  worldviewList.innerHTML = stmts.length === 0
    ? '<div class="worldview-pane__empty">No connections</div>'
    : stmts.map(n => {
        const sub = n.topic
          ? ' <span class="worldview-pane__item-sub">' + n.topic + '</span>' : '';
        return '<div class="worldview-pane__item" data-id="' + n.id + '">'
             + '<span class="worldview-pane__item-id">' + n.id + '</span>'
             + '<span class="worldview-pane__item-text">' + n.label + sub + '</span>'
             + '</div>';
      }).join("");

  // Hover over agent title highlights agent and all connected statements
  worldviewTitle.addEventListener("mouseenter", () => {
    const nb = new Set([d.id, ...(neighbours[d.id] || [])]);
    nodeSel.classed("node--highlighted", n =>  nb.has(n.id))
           .classed("node--dimmed",      n => !nb.has(n.id));
    linkSel.classed("edge--highlighted", l => l._s === d.id || l._t === d.id);
    linkSel.filter(function() { return d3.select(this).classed("edge--highlighted"); }).raise();
  });
  worldviewTitle.addEventListener("mouseleave", () => {
    nodeSel.classed("node--highlighted", false).classed("node--dimmed", false);
    linkSel.classed("edge--highlighted", false);
  });

  // Hover over item in pane highlights that statement node in graph
  worldviewList.querySelectorAll(".worldview-pane__item").forEach(el => {
    el.addEventListener("mouseenter", () => {
      const sid = el.dataset.id;
      nodeSel.classed("node--highlighted", n => n.id === sid || n.id === d.id)
             .classed("node--dimmed",      n => n.id !== sid && n.id !== d.id);
      linkSel.classed("edge--highlighted", l =>
        (l._s === d.id && l._t === sid) || (l._t === d.id && l._s === sid));
      linkSel.filter(function() { return d3.select(this).classed("edge--highlighted"); }).raise();
    });
    el.addEventListener("mouseleave", () => {
      nodeSel.classed("node--highlighted", false).classed("node--dimmed", false);
      linkSel.classed("edge--highlighted", false);
    });
    // Click on statement id to open that statement's pane
    const idSpan = el.querySelector(".worldview-pane__item-id");
    if (idSpan) {
      idSpan.addEventListener("click", (event) => {
        event.stopPropagation();
        const stmtId = el.dataset.id;
        const stmtNode = nodeById[stmtId];
        if (stmtNode) {
          worldviewPane.classList.remove("worldview-pane--visible");
          openStatementPane(stmtNode);
        }
      });
    }
  });

  worldviewPane.classList.add("worldview-pane--visible");
}

function openStatementPane(d) {
  const agents = Array.from(neighbours[d.id] || [])
    .map(id => nodeById[id])
    .filter(n => n && n.type === "agent")
    .sort((a, b) => a.id.localeCompare(b.id, undefined, {numeric: true}));

  // Update title with statement ID and text in statement color
  const titleEl = document.getElementById("statement-title");
  titleEl.innerHTML = '<span class="statement-id">' + d.id + '</span> <span class="statement-text">' + d.label + '</span>';
  
  // Add agent count info below title
  const statementList = document.getElementById("statement-list");
  const countInfo = agents.length === 0
    ? '<div class="statement-agents-info">0 agents connected</div>'
    : '<div class="statement-agents-info">' + agents.length + ' agents connected</div>';
  
  statementList.innerHTML = countInfo + (agents.length === 0
    ? '<div class="worldview-pane__empty">No connections</div>'
    : '<div class="statement-agents-list">' + agents.map(n => {
        return '<span class="agent-id" data-agent-id="' + n.id + '">' + n.id + '</span>';
      }).join('') + '</div>');

  // Hover over statement title highlights statement and all connected agents
  titleEl.onmouseenter = () => {
    const nb = new Set([d.id, ...(neighbours[d.id] || [])]);
    nodeSel.classed("node--highlighted", n =>  nb.has(n.id))
           .classed("node--dimmed",      n => !nb.has(n.id));
    linkSel.classed("edge--highlighted", l => l._s === d.id || l._t === d.id);
    linkSel.filter(function() { return d3.select(this).classed("edge--highlighted"); }).raise();
  };
  titleEl.onmouseleave = () => {
    nodeSel.classed("node--highlighted", false).classed("node--dimmed", false);
    linkSel.classed("edge--highlighted", false);
  };

  // Hover over agent ids highlights that agent node in graph
  statementList.querySelectorAll(".agent-id").forEach(el => {
    el.onmouseenter = () => {
      const agentId = el.dataset.agentId;
      nodeSel.classed("node--highlighted", n => n.id === agentId || n.id === d.id)
             .classed("node--dimmed",      n => n.id !== agentId && n.id !== d.id);
      linkSel.classed("edge--highlighted", l =>
        (l._s === d.id && l._t === agentId) || (l._t === d.id && l._s === agentId));
      linkSel.filter(function() { return d3.select(this).classed("edge--highlighted"); }).raise();
    };
    el.onmouseleave = () => {
      nodeSel.classed("node--highlighted", false).classed("node--dimmed", false);
      linkSel.classed("edge--highlighted", false);
    };
    // Click on agent id to open that agent's worldview
    el.addEventListener("click", (event) => {
      event.stopPropagation();
      const agentId = el.dataset.agentId;
      const agentNode = nodeById[agentId];
      if (agentNode) {
        document.getElementById("statement-pane").classList.remove("worldview-pane--visible");
        openWorldview(agentNode);
      }
    });
  });

  document.getElementById("statement-pane").classList.add("worldview-pane--visible");
}

function onClick(event, d) {
  event.stopPropagation();
  if (netType !== "AS") return;
  if (d.type === "agent") {
    document.getElementById("statement-pane").classList.remove("worldview-pane--visible");
    openWorldview(d);
  } else {
    worldviewPane.classList.remove("worldview-pane--visible");
    openStatementPane(d);
  }
}

document.getElementById("worldview-close").addEventListener("click", e => {
  e.stopPropagation();
  worldviewPane.classList.remove("worldview-pane--visible");
  nodeSel.classed("node--highlighted", false).classed("node--dimmed", false);
  linkSel.classed("edge--highlighted", false);
  // Unlock all nodes when closing panel
  DATA.nodes.forEach(d => { d.fx = null; d.fy = null; });
});

document.getElementById("statement-close").addEventListener("click", e => {
  e.stopPropagation();
  document.getElementById("statement-pane").classList.remove("worldview-pane--visible");
  nodeSel.classed("node--highlighted", false).classed("node--dimmed", false);
  linkSel.classed("edge--highlighted", false);
  // Unlock all nodes when closing panel
  DATA.nodes.forEach(d => { d.fx = null; d.fy = null; });
});

// ── Filter menu logic ─────────────────────────────────────────────
let allManifestEntries = [];

// Load manifest.json at runtime to populate filter dropdowns
fetch("manifest.json")
  .then(r => { if (!r.ok) throw new Error("HTTP " + r.status); return r.json(); })
  .then(data => {
    allManifestEntries = Array.isArray(data) ? data : [];
    if (allManifestEntries.length === 0) {
      document.getElementById("filter-status").textContent = "Manifest is empty.";
    } else {
      populateFilters();
    }
  })
  .catch(err => {
    document.getElementById("filter-status").textContent = "Manifest failed to load: " + err.message;
  });

function fillSelect(id, values, current) {
  const sel = document.getElementById(id);
  sel.innerHTML = "";
  values.forEach(val => {
    const opt = document.createElement("option");
    opt.value = val;
    opt.textContent = val;
    sel.appendChild(opt);
  });
  // Keep current value if still valid, otherwise pick first
  if (current !== null && values.includes(current)) sel.value = current;
  else if (values.length > 0) sel.value = values[0];
  return sel.value;
}

function populateFilters() {
  const uniq = key => [...new Set(allManifestEntries.map(e => e[key]))].sort((a, b) => a - b);

  fillSelect("filter-N",              uniq("N"),              null);
  fillSelect("filter-M",              uniq("M"),              null);
  fillSelect("filter-openmindedness", uniq("openmindedness"), null);
  fillSelect("filter-seed",           uniq("seed"),           null);
  fillSelect("filter-t",              uniq("t"),              null);

  // social_posting is pre-populated in HTML; just pick first meaningful option
  const postSel = document.getElementById("filter-social_posting");
  // default to "any" — updateRunOptions will refine
  postSel.value = "";

  // Attach listeners: top-6 filters repopulate Run then auto-load
  ["filter-N", "filter-M", "filter-openmindedness", "filter-social_posting",
   "filter-seed", "filter-t"].forEach(id => {
    document.getElementById(id).addEventListener("change", updateRunOptions);
  });

  // Run filter: user choosing a run triggers load
  document.getElementById("filter-run").addEventListener("change", tryAutoLoad);

  // Initial population of Run + first auto-load
  updateRunOptions();
}

function getTopFilters() {
  const v = id => document.getElementById(id).value;
  return { N: v("filter-N"), M: v("filter-M"), open: v("filter-openmindedness"),
           post: v("filter-social_posting"), seed: v("filter-seed"), t: v("filter-t") };
}

function matchesTopFilters(e, f) {
  return (f.N    === "" || e.N              == f.N)    &&
         (f.M    === "" || e.M              == f.M)    &&
         (f.open === "" || e.openmindedness == f.open) &&
         (f.post === "" || (f.post === "true" ? e.social_posting : !e.social_posting)) &&
         (f.seed === "" || e.seed           == f.seed) &&
         (f.t    === "" || e.t              == f.t);
}

function updateRunOptions() {
  const f = getTopFilters();

  // All entries matching the top 6 filters
  const candidates = allManifestEntries.filter(e => matchesTopFilters(e, f));

  // Unique timestamps among candidates, sorted
  const runs = [...new Set(candidates.map(e => e.timestamp))].sort();

  const runSel = document.getElementById("filter-run");
  const prev   = runSel.value;
  fillSelect("filter-run", runs, prev);

  const statusEl = document.getElementById("filter-status");
  if (candidates.length === 0) {
    statusEl.textContent = "No files found";
    statusEl.style.color = "#d00";
  } else {
    statusEl.textContent = `${runs.length} run${runs.length !== 1 ? "s" : ""} available`;
    statusEl.style.color = "#888";
  }

  tryAutoLoad();
}

function resolveEntry() {
  const f   = getTopFilters();
  const run = document.getElementById("filter-run").value;
  return allManifestEntries.find(e => matchesTopFilters(e, f) && e.timestamp === run) || null;
}

function fetchAndLoad(entry) {
  document.getElementById("status-bar").textContent = "Loading\u2026";
  fetch(entry.file)
    .then(r => { if (!r.ok) throw new Error("HTTP " + r.status); return r.json(); })
    .then(data => loadData(data, entry.file.split("/").pop()))
    .catch(err => {
      document.getElementById("status-bar").textContent = "Failed to load: " + err.message;
    });
}

function tryAutoLoad() {
  const entry = resolveEntry();
  if (entry) fetchAndLoad(entry);
}

// Load button is now a fallback / manual trigger (should rarely be needed)
document.getElementById("btn-load-selected").style.display = "none";
document.getElementById("btn-load-selected").addEventListener("click", () => {
  const entry = resolveEntry();
  if (entry) fetchAndLoad(entry);
  else alert("No matching file found.");
});

// ── Local file loader ─────────────────────────────────────────────
document.getElementById("file-input").addEventListener("change", function() {
  const file = this.files[0];
  if (!file) return;
  const reader = new FileReader();
  reader.onload = e => {
    try {
      loadData(JSON.parse(e.target.result), file.name);
    } catch(err) {
      alert("Could not parse JSON: " + err.message);
    }
  };
  reader.readAsText(file);
  this.value = "";
});

function setSliders(d) {
  document.getElementById("sl-spread").value  = d.spread;
  document.getElementById("vl-spread").textContent = d.spread;
  document.getElementById("sl-edgelen").value = d.edgelen;
  document.getElementById("vl-edgelen").textContent = d.edgelen;
  document.getElementById("sl-attract").value = d.attract;
  document.getElementById("vl-attract").textContent = d.attract.toFixed(3).replace(/\.?0+$/, "");
}

function applyWeightFilter() {
  minWeight = sv("sl-minweight");
  const typeFilter = netType === "AA" ? l => l.type === "AA" : l => l.type === "SS";
  DATA.links = (rawData.links || []).filter(typeFilter).filter(l => (l.weight || 1) >= minWeight);
  tagLinks();
  buildIndex();
  redrawLinks();
  // Replace link force with new link set, preserving node positions
  sim.force("link", d3.forceLink(DATA.links).id(d => d.id)
    .distance(sv("sl-edgelen")).strength(linkStrength()));
  sim.alpha(0.3).restart();
}

function applyNetType() {
  netType = document.getElementById("filter-nettype").value;
  // Sync projection-only controls
  const wfBtn    = document.getElementById("btn-weight-forces");
  const mwSlider = document.getElementById("sl-minweight");
  const mwLabel  = document.getElementById("vl-minweight");
  minWeight = 1;
  mwSlider.value = 1;
  mwLabel.textContent = "1";
  if (netType === "AS") {
    weightedForces = false;
    wfBtn.disabled = true;
    wfBtn.classList.remove("btn--active");
    wfBtn.textContent = "Weight forces: off";
    mwSlider.disabled = true;
  } else {
    wfBtn.disabled = false;
    mwSlider.disabled = false;
  }
  if (netType === "AS") {
    DATA.nodes = rawData.nodes ? rawData.nodes.slice() : [];
    DATA.links = rawData.links ? rawData.links.filter(l => !l.type || l.type === "AS") : [];
  } else if (netType === "AA") {
    DATA.nodes = rawData.nodes ? rawData.nodes.filter(n => n.type === "agent") : [];
    DATA.links = rawData.links ? rawData.links.filter(l => l.type === "AA" && (l.weight || 1) >= minWeight) : [];
  } else { // SS
    DATA.nodes = rawData.nodes ? rawData.nodes.filter(n => n.type === "statement") : [];
    DATA.links = rawData.links ? rawData.links.filter(l => l.type === "SS" && (l.weight || 1) >= minWeight) : [];
  }
  // Close side panes when switching away from bipartite view
  if (netType !== "AS") {
    worldviewPane.classList.remove("worldview-pane--visible");
    document.getElementById("statement-pane").classList.remove("worldview-pane--visible");
  }
  // Apply layout defaults for this network type
  setSliders(NET_DEFAULTS[netType]);
  tagLinks();
  buildIndex();
  DATA.nodes.forEach(d => { d.x=undefined; d.y=undefined; d.vx=0; d.vy=0; d.fx=null; d.fy=null; });
  redraw();
  buildSim();
  sim.alpha(1).restart();
}

function loadData(newData, filename) {
  rawData = newData;
  // Show filename
  document.getElementById("loaded-name").textContent = filename.replace(/\.json$/i, "");
  worldviewPane.classList.remove("worldview-pane--visible");
  document.getElementById("statement-pane").classList.remove("worldview-pane--visible");
  frozen = false;
  document.getElementById("btn-freeze").textContent = "\u23F8 Freeze";
  // Reset to bipartite view on new file load
  document.getElementById("filter-nettype").value = "AS";
  applyNetType();
}

// ── Resize ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
window.addEventListener("resize", () => {
  if (!frozen) {
    const [W, H] = wh();
    sim.force("center", d3.forceCenter(W / 2, H / 2));
    sim.alpha(0.2).restart();
  }
});
</script>
</div>
```
